name: The Rape of the Lock
source:
Based on Alexander Pope's classic mock-heroic poem, The Rape of the Lock explores the petty squabbles of the Beau-monde through comparison to the world of Greek epics and the divine. Set in early Georgian England, young Belinda is an innocent and virginal nymph guarded constantly by her Sylphs. However, one day after playing cards with the Baron she finds her beauty and honor at stake, subject to his 'glitt'ring forfex'...

[Edited from [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=12066]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
本作改编自亚历山大·蒲柏的经典拟英雄诗《夺发记》，通过与希腊史诗和神界相提并论，描绘上流社交界鸡毛蒜皮的争端。故事设定在英国乔治王朝初期，年轻的贝琳达如同纯洁无瑕的仙女，时刻受到风精守护。然而一天，她与男爵打完牌后，自己的美貌与名誉竟危在旦夕，落在他那把“闪闪发亮的剪刀”之下……
